# Lab 9.7: Notebook Gallery & Templates

## What We Are Going to Do
Start from a notebook gallery template and adapt it to your own data.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Open the gallery.** In Studio click **+ → Notebook → Notebook gallery**. Browse the categories: getting started, BigQuery DataFrames, ML, generative AI, Spark.

2. **[Console] Pick a template.** Open the **BigQuery DataFrames quickstart** (or a forecasting template) and click **Use template**. A copy is saved to your Files.

3. **[Console] Adapt it.** Change the table to `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` and the target dataset to `lab09`. Run all cells. Fix any column names the template expects.

4. **[Console] Save as your own template.** Rename the copy `lab09_my_template` and share it with your team so they can start from it.

5. **[CLI] Clean up the runtime template if you no longer need it.**
